slots.title: Apple, Meta reject OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans, leaving crypto firms as the ones to watch
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Strategy, Coinbase, Circle and Robinhood are among six companies from the venture’s initial selection with no disclosed objection, after 90% of issuers opted out.

slots.title: U.S. prediction markets regulator issues demand that clashes directly with courts
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission said regulated exchanges can't cut off customers state-by-state, but firms like Kalshi are under court orders to do so.

slots.title: Meta introduces Spaces, a new way to collaborate with your Muse agent
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Meta's Muse agents continue to get new features and integrations. Spaces promises to be a new way to interact with the AI helpers.

slots.title: Binance hack is ‘cyber war,’ TRM Labs executive says
slots.author: Cointelegraph
slots.summary: TRM Labs executive Ari Redbord called for governments to take offensive action against North Korean hackers following the record $6.3 billion Binance theft.

slots.title: Bitcoin steadies after AI-led selloff as eyes turn to latest U.S. jobs figures
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Bitcoin bounced from around $75,200 after Thursday’s AI-led selloff, which drove more than $1 billion in liquidations, as traders await the U.S. jobs report.
slots.reason: A major development affecting both AI and blockchain

slots.title: Hundreds of Artex AI hacking tools found publicly exposed to the web
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Security researchers found hundreds of servers hosting the penetration testing tool Artex exposed to the internet, allowing anyone access to the hacking tool.
slots.reason: Outside your usual reads — worth a skim
